# Test fixtures

Small Lance data files used by `tests/info.rs` and the unit tests in
`src/format/container.rs`. They are checked in so the test suite does not need a
Lance checkout or Python environment.

| File | Format | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `v2_0.lance` | v2.0 (footer `0.3`) | `lance/test_data/v0.16.0/wrong_data_version_no_fix.lance/data/518e8ab1-f105-4e72-a615-15e82f0c47bd.lance` |
| `v2_1.lance` | v2.1 | `lance/test_data/fri_straddle_pre_6610/fri_straddle_dataset/data/1101010010001101110110003e36734fffa25e4ce82d350e11.lance` |
| `v2_2.lance` | v2.2 | `lance/test_data/v6.0.1/miniblock_level_count_overflow.lance/data/110111010100010000111011182b1d41469840c6b679aeab55.lance` |
| `v1.lance` | v1 (footer `0.1`) | `lance/test_data/v0.10.5/corrupt_schema/data/25c37abd-c753-419b-b420-4847ce2de5a1.lance` |
| `variable_strings.lance` | v2.2, mini-block + variable values | Local test file (`data/nested-empty-students.data.lance`), 4 rows of single-character strings |

`v2_2.lance` is generated by
`lance/test_data/v6.0.1/datagen.py`: 513 dense rows of 32-item lists followed by
65,536 empty/null rows, which exercises rep/def buffers and the repetition index.
